title: Dual-Locking Learned AI Models: A PIN-Based Sparse QIM Watermarking and Adaptive Index Permutation Approach
abstract: arXiv:2609.22981v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We present a dual-locking method for securing trained neural networks that combines key-driven index permutation with PIN-based watermarking based on Sparse Quantization Index Modulation (QIM). Cryptographic randomness is introduced by independently applying a uniform random permutation to each row of adaptively selected index vectors. A robust blind binary watermark is then embedded into the bias coefficients by modulating their quantized values, binding the network to a user-defined Personal Identification Number (PIN). Without the correct key, the network retains its architecture but becomes functionally impaired due to disrupted internal representations. Inverse permutation fully restores the original model accuracy, while the embedded watermark remains imperceptible and enables blind verification of key association and model authorship. translated_title: 双重锁定学习型AI模型：基于PIN的稀疏QIM水印与自适应索引置换方法
translated_abstract: 我们提出了一种用于保护已训练神经网络的双重锁定方法，该方法将密钥驱动的索引置换与基于稀疏量化索引调制（QIM）的PIN水印技术相结合。通过对自适应选择的索引向量的每一行独立应用均匀随机置换来引入密码学随机性。随后，通过调制偏置系数的量化值，将鲁棒的盲二进制水印嵌入其中，从而将网络与用户定义的个人识别码（PIN）绑定。在没有正确密钥的情况下，网络虽然保留其架构，但由于内部表示被破坏而在功能上受损。逆置换可以完全恢复原始模型的精度，同时嵌入的水印保持不可感知，并能够对密钥关联和模型所有权进行盲验证。为了提高锁定效果和可恢复性，一种自适应密钥选择策略……
tldr: 该论文提出了一种双重锁定方法，通过密钥驱动的自适应索引置换与基于PIN的稀疏QIM水印相结合来保护已训练的神经网络，使模型在无正确密钥时功能受损，而使用正确密钥可完全恢复精度并实现模型所有权的盲验证。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a dual-locking method that secures trained neural networks by combining key-driven adaptive index permutation with PIN-based sparse QIM watermarking, rendering the model functionally impaired without the correct key while enabling full accuracy restoration and blind verification of model authorship.
